name: last30days-skill
description: AI agent skill that researches any topic across Reddit, X, YouTube, HN, Polymarket, and the web - then synthesizes a grounded summary
one_liner: An assistant that reads what real people are saying right now across Reddit, X, YouTube, and the web about any topic, and gives you an honest, grounded summary instead of guesses.
buyer: A marketing agency or brand manager who needs a fast, honest read on what people are actually saying about their brand or competitors.
business_use_cases: A marketing agency sells a weekly 'what the internet is saying about your brand' digest to small and medium business clients.
A startup founder commissions a one-off competitive intelligence report before a product launch.
A niche industry newsletter uses it to spot and summarize emerging trends every week for subscribers.

money_ideas.idea: Subscription weekly brand/competitor 'pulse report' service for small businesses
One-off competitive research report sold per project before a launch

steal_this: Sell a $50 one-time 'what's the internet saying about your brand' report to a local business this weekend.
